channel.title: Advanced Civic Planning
channel.description: A 36-episode advanced course in public hearings, land use, housing, transportation, environmental justice, and municipal finance.
channel.itunes:author: Advanced Civic Planning

item.title: Capstone: Evaluate a Torrance Project
item.description: Combines legal, planning, transportation, housing, and fiscal tests in a documented project review.

item.title: Enterprise Funds, Partnerships, and Reserves
item.description: Evaluates restricted funds, partnerships, reserves, and risk allocation in municipal finance.

item.title: Municipal Debt and Long-Term Commitments
item.description: Explains debt structure, affordability, disclosure, and long-term fiscal commitments.

item.title: Comparing Project Alternatives
item.description: Uses consistent baselines, lifecycle costs, uncertainty, and public outcomes to compare alternatives.

item.title: Operating Costs After the Ribbon Cutting
item.description: Identifies staffing, maintenance, renewal, and risk costs that continue after capital completion.

item.title: Economic Development and Land Value Capture
item.description: Compares economic development tools and ways public action can recover created land value.

item.title: Property Tax and Development Fiscal Impact
item.description: Tests development fiscal claims against property tax allocation, service costs, and timing.

item.title: Revenues and California's Fiscal Constitution
item.description: Maps local revenue tools, legal constraints, volatility, and accountability.

item.title: The Fiscal Test for Every City Decision
item.description: Frames fiscal analysis around recurring revenues, lifecycle costs, risk, and service outcomes.

item.title: Reading Maps, Census Data, and Greenprint
item.description: Builds habits for checking geography, vintage, uncertainty, access, and licensing in planning data.

item.title: Environmental Justice and Regional Resilience
item.description: Connects cumulative burdens, participation, investment, and climate resilience in regional planning.

item.title: Projects, Safety, and Reliable Transit
item.description: Evaluates transportation projects through safety, reliability, access, and development process.

item.title: From Level of Service to Vehicle Miles Traveled
item.description: Distinguishes traffic operations from environmental transportation impact under current guidance.

item.title: Protecting Housing Capacity After Approval
item.description: Explains how implementation, replacement capacity, monitoring, and enforcement protect planned housing.

item.title: The Ministerial Pathways Decision Tree
item.description: Organizes housing approval pathways by eligibility, objective standards, and current legal authority.

item.title: Objective Standards and the Processing Clock
item.description: Separates objective standards from discretion and tracks review deadlines that change local process.

item.title: Reading the APR and HCD Enforcement
item.description: Uses annual progress reports and enforcement guidance to evaluate housing program delivery.

item.title: The Housing Element as an Implementation Contract
item.description: Reads the housing element as a schedule of sites, programs, deadlines, and accountable actions.

item.title: Infill, Transit, and Resilient Growth
item.description: Connects infill and transit decisions to resilience, access, displacement, and implementation.

item.title: Streets Are Public Places
item.description: Evaluates streets as civic spaces serving access, safety, mobility, commerce, and public life.

item.title: The Five Urban Design Policy Tools
item.description: Compares regulation, investment, incentives, information, and coordination as design tools.

item.title: Beyond Conventional Zoning
item.description: Compares conventional zoning with form, performance, overlay, incentive, and hybrid tools.

item.title: Zoning History, Exclusion, and Legitimacy
item.description: Places zoning tools in their legal and exclusionary history and tests present legitimacy.

item.title: Growth Management Across Municipal Borders
item.description: Analyzes regional infrastructure, housing, transportation, and environmental spillovers.

item.title: Making and Evaluating a Community Plan
item.description: Builds a practical framework for community plan goals, evidence, implementation, and evaluation.

item.title: Eight Elements, One System
item.description: Explains how California general plan elements interact instead of operating as separate documents.

item.title: The General Plan After Adoption
item.description: Treats the general plan as an implementation system that requires monitoring and adjustment.

item.title: Capstone: Run a Defensible Public Hearing
item.description: Applies procedure, evidence, findings, and motion practice to a complete hearing.

item.title: Evidence, Findings, and the Administrative Record
item.description: Connects governing standards to record evidence and reasoned findings.

item.title: Growth Coalitions and Regional Spillovers
item.description: Explains how local development choices distribute benefits and costs across municipal borders.

item.title: Who Really Governs a City
item.description: Compares formal authority with administrative, political, economic, and community influence.

item.title: The City as a Legal Creature
item.description: Maps local authority through state law, charters, police power, and delegated planning duties.

item.title: Equity and Engagement Beyond the Microphone
item.description: Shows how engagement design and evidence can include people who are absent from a hearing room.

item.title: Ethics, Ex Parte Contacts, and Recusal
item.description: Examines ethical duties, outside contacts, disclosure, bias, and recusal in local hearings.

item.title: Procedure Is Part of the Decision
item.description: Explains why notice, hearing procedure, records, and fair process are part of a defensible decision.

item.title: Reading a Staff Report Like an Analyst
item.description: A method for testing authority, evidence, findings, and conditions in a planning staff report.
